title: Self-Improving AI Harnesses: Latest Research
summary: Julian Ghadially shows agent-directed search matches evolutionary AI harness optimization.
learn: Agent-directed search is just as good, if not better, than evolutionary search.
Evolution was beneficial on the old models, but it's just not seen anymore with models that are much more capable coding agents.
There's literally no difference between the exploration for the Pareto evolution versus the agent-directed search.
The starting state for agent-directed search doesn't matter so much, because if it has a bunch of bugs, the agent will usually find those bugs, fix them.
